answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 10909 Country: India Title: Assalamualikum Mufti Sb., Is it permissible to do Marriage younger brother if the Elder brother Marriage is not done due to elder brother is working in Gulf. Question: Assalamualikum Mufti Sb., Is it permissible to do Marriage younger brother if the Elder brother Marriage is not done due to elder brother is working in Gulf. Answer ID: 10909 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 224/223=M/1430) It is alright, but the elder brother also should not delay his marriage. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
